entries.title: Control public assembly visibility
entries.description: Choose which standard and optional assemblies appear on the public website and in product brochures while keeping internal assemblies private.

entries.title: Export and re-import Parts
entries.description: Download the full Parts catalog, or one supplier’s Parts, as a bulk-import-ready CSV for safer spreadsheet editing and re-importing.

entries.title: Improve brochure branding
entries.description: Product brochures now display larger range logos while preserving the two-page layout.

entries.title: Clarify blocked unit removals
entries.description: When a unit cannot be removed, the message now identifies the live or completed Job responsible.

entries.title: Show only approved assemblies
entries.description: Public product pages now display only the standard and optional assemblies approved for public visibility.

entries.title: Cancel locked Quotes
entries.description: Authorized users can now cancel locked Quotes directly from the mobile Quote screen, with related Jobs and Units refreshing after cancellation.
